Metadata.title: Zentrix — Omnichannel customer service with AI
Metadata.description: Answer WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger from one inbox. An AI assistant trained on your business data serves customers, and your team can take over any time. 14 days free, no card.

features.title: Everything you need to serve
features.subtitle: One Inbox for your team, the AI and your channels.

team.title: A team with roles
team.text: Invite colleagues by email as Owner, Manager or Agent. Everyone sees the same conversations and each person can only do what their role allows.

ai.title: AI trained on your business profile
ai.text: The assistant answers with what you write in the profile: products, prices, hours and rules. With no profile, it stays silent: it doesn't make things up. Pause it in any conversation to reply yourself.

queue.title: Paced sending
queue.text: Replies go out through a queue with controlled pacing and retries, to protect your number from being blocked for sending too much.

security.title: Data isolated per company
security.text: Each organization only sees its own data. Isolation is enforced in the database and channel credentials are stored encrypted.

faq.title: Your questions,
faq.subtitle: Straight answers about how Zentrix works.

q1.question: Which channels can I connect?
q1.answer: WhatsApp (through Meta's official API), Instagram (professional account) and Messenger (Facebook Page). All of them land in the same Inbox.

q2.question: Will I lose my WhatsApp number?
q2.answer: WhatsApp connects through Meta's official API. We recommend a dedicated number. If you connect a number you already use in the WhatsApp phone app, that number stops working in the app.

q3.question: Can several people handle conversations?
q3.answer: Yes. Invite your team by email (up to 5 people) as Owner, Manager or Agent. Everyone sees the same conversations in the Inbox.

q4.question: How does the AI work?
q4.answer: The AI answers based on the business profile you fill in: products, prices, hours and rules. If the information isn't in the profile, it doesn't make it up. You can turn it on or off, and pause it in each conversation to reply yourself.

q5.question: Can the AI make mistakes?
q5.answer: Yes. AI replies can contain errors or omissions. Review your profile, follow conversations in the Inbox and take over when needed.

q6.question: Is my data safe?
q6.answer: Each company only sees its own data and channel credentials are stored encrypted. You can delete your account and all data whenever you want.

q7.question: Do I need a credit card to try it?
q7.answer: No. The free trial lasts 14 days and starts without a card.

q8.question: How much does it cost?
q8.answer: After the trial there is a single plan with everything included. The price is shown before you subscribe, no surprises.

q9.question: Can I cancel anytime?
q9.answer: Yes, no lock-in. Cancel in the billing portal at any time.

q10.question: What language is the platform in?
q10.answer: The dashboard is in Portuguese. The website and sign-up are also available in English and Spanish.
